name: Cold Start and Bootstrapping
definition: The design requires accumulated standing, participants, or history that it provides no way to acquire.
trigger_conditions: Participation requires staking standing the new entrant cannot yet have earned
Initial population is zero or below the quorum the mechanism assumes
No provisional, sponsored, or probationary entry path exists

institutional_antecedent.mechanism: entry problem where adjudication requires staking reputation one does not yet hold

citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F003 Cold Start and Bootstrapping. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F003
assessment_note: State which trigger conditions the assessed design satisfies. Report this family as examined even where no exposure is found. A parameter recommendation stated without its conditions is not conforming output under section 7.
